info.title: SafeCube Backend API
info.description: Zero-knowledge backend API. The server never inspects or interprets encrypted payloads.

put.description: Updates the master-wrapped key material after passphrase change. Does not modify existing vault items.

get.description: Returns a vault item by id. The payload is opaque encrypted data.

put.description: Updates an existing vault item. The payload is opaque encrypted data. Conflicts may occur on stale updates.

delete.description: Soft-deletes a vault item for the authenticated account.

get.description: Returns the user profile for the authenticated account.

put.description: Updates editable profile fields for the authenticated account.

post.description: Creates a non-sensitive user profile for the authenticated account.

get.description: Returns the stored wrapped key material and crypto/KDF parameters for the authenticated account.

post.description: Stores wrapped key material and KDF parameters. All fields are opaque; the backend never derives or decrypts keys.

get.description: Lists vault items for sync/listing. Supports filters and optional inclusion of deleted items.

post.description: Creates a new vault item for the authenticated account. The payload is opaque encrypted data.
Creates an authentication account using email and password.
Exchanges a refresh token for a new access/refresh token pair.
Revokes the current session / refresh token family for the authenticated account.
Authenticates credentials and returns access/refresh tokens.

get.description: Returns complete encrypted snapshots ordered by a server-owned change cursor.

UpdateMasterWrappedKekRequest.description: Request to update the master-wrapped KEK after a passphrase change. Opaque client-produced bytes; the backend does not decrypt or derive keys.

UpdateSecureItemRequest.description: Request to update a vault item. The payload is opaque encrypted data produced by the client; the backend does not inspect it. Concurrency is enforced through the If-Match item revision.

schemaVersion.description: Schema version for the client-side item format. Used by clients to handle migrations.

displayHint.description: Non-sensitive display hint (e.g., title) used for listing.

UpdateUserProfileRequest.description: Request to update the user profile for the authenticated account.

displayName.description: Public display name shown in the UI.

InitVaultKeyMaterialRequest.description: Request to initialize vault key material. All byte arrays are opaque encrypted/wrapped values produced by the client. The backend never derives or decrypts keys (zero-knowledge).

kdfAlgorithm.description: KDF algorithm identifier used by the client (e.g., argon2id).

CreateSecureItemRequest.description: Request to create a vault item. The payload is opaque encrypted data produced by the client; the backend does not inspect it.

schemaVersion.description: Schema version for the client-side item format. Used by clients to handle migrations.

displayHint.description: Non-sensitive display hint (e.g., title) used for listing.

CreateUserProfileRequest.description: Request to create a user profile for the authenticated account.

displayName.description: Public display name shown in the UI.

RegisterAccountRequest.description: Registration request using email and password.

refreshToken.description: Refresh token previously issued by the server.
Refresh token used to obtain new token pairs.

issuedAt.description: Instant when the token pair was issued.

AuthenticateAccountRequest.description: Authentication request using email and password.
